name: Steak & Bone service corridors
required_outputs: Nine-panel location sheet: hero wide, north/south/east/west coverage, overhead plan with camera markers, ceiling/floor, fixed props/materials, reverse wide
Separate clean full-resolution 16:9 hero and reverse plates, without grid labels
Annotated overhead layout with fixed door/window/prop coordinates and screen axis
Lighting/material palette and day/night variants only when script needs them
Blank screens and signage areas plus separate exact typography overlays
QC record, source references, prompt, model/version, dimensions and file hash
qa_notes: Both wides read as a straight corridor with opposite end doors. The plan depicts an L-shaped corridor; the reverse from its northern dining door could not see the west exterior exit directly as rendered.

Hero places the exterior double exit on the same side wall as the kitchen door/hatch, while the plan and WEST elevation place it at the west end. Burgundy dining door appears at the far east end in the hero rather than around the northward turn.
The trolley alcove appears near the kitchen-side wall in the hero, while its intended position is the south wall as shown by the SOUTH panel and plan.
Retain material and prop design; rebuild hero and reverse from the L-shaped plan and lock all door/alcove positions before camera blocking.
Generated sheets are review drafts, not production-approved camera or geometry masters.
Empty utility corridor, kitchen hatch, trolley alcove, rear exit, security camera/alarm and floor/ceiling details included.

L-shaped plan is explicit but hero/reverse visuals partly read as a straight corridor; use one approved camera path and reconcile the bend before action/escape clips. Private-room service-door frosted strip is a proposed detail and must match LOC12 in later renders.
